reader_summary.headline: Hi and welcome to the A16Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi and welcome to the A16Z podcast. This conversation is all about the business of cybercrime and is a rerun of one of our popular episodes on security from last year. The episode with Joel de la Garza, operating partner of information security at A16Z and former CISO at Box, myself and Jonathan Lusthouse.
